overview:
**Fire danger is High today across the Montrose (High Elevation) area, driven by dry fuels — ERC at 76% and climbing.**
- Danger is forecast to rise through the week, reaching Very High by Thursday as ERC climbs to 93% and BI to 86%.
- Winds stay northeasterly and increase to 11 mph by midweek while afternoon humidity drops into the low 20s—a drying trend to watch.
- No local watchout thresholds are triggered (0 of 7), and no Red Flag Warning is active for today.
- Montrose and San Miguel counties remain under Stage 2 fire restrictions, with BLM's Uncompahgre Field Office under Stage 1.
- The Gold Mountain Fire, two miles northeast of Ouray, was reported Friday at 39,675 acres and 87% containment; crews continue structure and infrastructure protection along the Highway 550 corridor.
